blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative driving planners can represent diverse ego futures, but a downstream scorer can choose only among sampled candidates; it cannot recover an absent maneuver. We present ForeseeDrive, which turns future scene evolution into a deployable interface for shaping candidate generation. Rather than reconstructing dense future states or scoring a fixed menu, ForeseeDrive derives query-indexed tokens from logged actor motion, occupancy evolution, route interactions, and TTC margins, and predicts the same token space from present context at deployment. The tokens condition trajectory geometry before candidates materialize. A zero-token-gated residual path and candidate-preservation loss limit unnecessary drift, while a TTC-margin guard targets brittle safe-to-unsafe boundary crossings. Under their respective benchmark protocols, ForeseeDrive reaches 89.2 PDMS on NAVSIM navtest, 0.41\,m average L2 and 0.05\% collision rate on nuScenes validation, and a 76.50 driving score on Bench2Drive. Controlled DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostics show an exact zero-token no-op, a small aligned-over-shuffled selected-PDM advantage under preservation, mixed oracle-best quality, and localized TTC-boundary failures. Together, the benchmark results and bounded mechanism tests support future-conditioned generation as a practical interface for anticipation. Code is included in the supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 基因驱动规划者可以代表不同的自负未来,但下游计分员只能从抽样候选人中选择;它无法恢复没有的策略。 我们介绍ForeseeDrive,它将未来场景的演化转化为塑造候选一代的可部署界面. ForeseeDrive 与其重建密集的未来状态或评分固定菜单,不如从登录的演员运动、占用进化、路线互动和TTC边距中获取有查询索引的标志,并在部署时从当前上下文中预测同样的标志空间。 信使在考生出现之前 将轨迹几何化 零接力的剩余路径和后备人员的损失限制了不必要的漂移,而TTC-边距警卫则瞄准安全到不安全的不便过境点。 根据各自的基准协议,ForeseeDrive在NAVSIM导航测试上达到89.2 PDMS,在nuScenes验证上达到0.41\,m平均L2和0.05\%相撞率,在Bench2Drive上达到76.50的驱动分. 受控分泌Drive/NAVSIM诊断显示精确为0-token no-op,在保存下有小型对接而成的选择性PDM优势,混合甲骨文-最佳质量,以及本地化的TTC-边界故障. 基准结果和限定机制测试共同支持未来有条件的生成,作为预测的实际界面。 守则包括在补充材料中。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous driving planning maps recent observations, map context, and route goals into safe, progressive ego motion [ 1 , 43 , 4 , 48 , 2 , 8 ] . Recent end-to-end and generative planners reduce brittleness by representing multiple ego futures rather than committing to one trajectory [ 6 , 15 , 21 , 29 ] . Yet a generative planner can still fail even when the appropriate behavior is clear in hindsight. The challenge is not only uncertain interaction: the planner must instantiate ego modes before those interactions fully unfold. Once a candidate set is materialized, a downstream scorer can only reorder sampled trajectories; it cannot recover a yielding, braking, nudging, or passing maneuver absent from that set. As Figure 1 illustrates, anticipation can therefore fail as a support-allocation problem before it becomes a ranking problem.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶规划地图 近期观测,地图背景,路线目标进入安全,渐进的自我运动 [1,43,4,48,2,8]. 近期的端到端规划者和基因规划者通过代表多种自我未来而不是致力于一种轨迹[6, 15, 21, 29]来减少疲软. 然而,即使事后发现适当行为明确,基因规划者仍可能失败。 挑战不仅仅是不确定的互动:规划者必须在这些互动充分展开之前即时提出自我模式。 一旦一个候选集被实现,下游计分员只能重新排序抽样的轨迹;它无法恢复一个没有从该集中获得的产物、制动、裸体或通过操作。 如图1所示,因此,预期作为一个支助分配问题,在成为排名问题之前就可能失败。

blocks.en: This view exposes a mismatch between future prediction and trajectory generation. Existing future-centric methods demonstrate the value of actor forecasting, occupancy/BEV prediction, and future-aware planning [ 10 , 22 , 13 , 31 , 53 , 55 , 52 ] . A dense rollout, however, describes the scene broadly, whereas a generator needs compact future evidence that changes which ego modes receive probability mass. Conversely, future-aware scoring introduces anticipation only after the candidate menu is fixed and remains bounded by sampled support. What is missing is a deployable, planner-facing future representation that acts before candidate materialization.
blocks.zh: 这种观点暴露了未来预测和轨迹生成之间的不匹配. 现有以未来为中心的方法显示了演员预测,占用/BEV预测,以及未来意识规划[10,22,13,31,53,55,52]的价值. 然而,密集的推出大致描述了场景,而发电机则需要紧凑的未来证据,证明自我模式的变化得到概率质量。 反之,未来意识的评分只有在候选人菜单固定并仍然以抽样支持为界之后,才引入预期。 所缺少的是一个可部署的、规划者未来的代表,在候选人实现之前采取行动。

blocks.en: We propose ForeseeDrive to provide this interface. Its central idea is to distill future scene evolution into compact tokens that answer action-relevant planning queries and enter the generator before sampling. During training, logged actor motion, occupancy changes, route interactions, and time-to-collision (TTC) margins supervise the token space; at deployment, a predictor estimates the same variables using only present observation history, map, and route. The predicted tokens can reshape trajectory geometry and mode allocation rather than only the final scores of a fixed set.
blocks.zh: 我们建议ForeseeDrive提供这个接口. 其中心思想是将未来的场景演化分解成紧凑的符号,回答与行动相关的规划询问,并在采样前输入生成器. 在培训期间,登录的演员运动、占用变化、路线相互作用和时间与曲线边距对象征性空间进行监督;在部署时,一个预测器只使用目前的观测历史、地图和路线来估计同样的变量。 预测的符号可以重塑轨迹几何和模式分配,而不只是固定集的最终分数.

blocks.en: The resulting representation is queryable and action-facing: tokens answer local planning questions rather than reconstruct every actor state or BEV cell. They capture whether an actor is becoming route-relevant, whether a reachable corridor will be contested or cleared, and whether an interaction lies near a TTC-sensitive boundary. This makes the representation lower-dimensional than a dense rollout, richer than a scalar risk score, and better aligned with generative planning decisions.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的表现是可质询的和可采取行动的:符号回答当地的规划问题,而不是重建每个演员状态或BEV细胞. 它们记录了一个行为者是否正在变得与路线相关,一个可到达的走廊是否会受到争议或被清除,以及互动是否位于一个对TTC敏感的边界附近。 这使得代表比密集的展开更低维,比标量风险分数更丰富,更符合基因规划决定.

blocks.en: Generation-time future conditioning creates a second tension: the signal must be expressive enough to move candidate modes, yet restrained enough not to corrupt strong candidates from a pretrained planner. ForeseeDrive resolves this tension with an architectural zero-token no-op, candidate preservation, and a margin-aware TTC guard. The preservation loss limits nonzero-token drift when future evidence is weak or irrelevant. The guard targets narrow safe-to-unsafe boundary crossings rather than imposing a broad clearance preference, which would also penalize controlled interactions [ 37 , 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 代际未来条件制造了第二个紧张:信号必须足够表现力来移动候选模式,但又有足够的约束力来腐蚀来自事先受过训练的规划师的强者候选人. ForeseeDrive通过一个建筑零托肯不op,候选保存,以及有边角意识的TTC守卫来解决这种紧张. 保全损失限制了未来证据薄弱或无关时的非零位漂移。 警卫的目标是狭窄的安全到不安全的边界过境点,而不是实行广泛的清除优先,这也将惩罚受控制的互动[37、7、8]。

blocks.en: Experiments evaluate both benchmark performance and the proposed mechanism. On NAVSIM navtest, ForeseeDrive reaches 89.2 PDMS and 83.5 EP; on nuScenes validation, it attains 0.41 m average L2 and 0.05% collision rate; and on Bench2Drive, it reaches a 76.50 driving score and 53.06 success rate. Same-backbone diagnostics then separate generation from selection: zero tokens exactly preserve the base candidates, aligned tokens modestly outperform shuffled tokens on selected PDM under preservation, and TTC replay localizes boundary-crossing failures. Oracle-best quality remains mixed, so we interpret these diagnostics as evidence for controllable support allocation, not universal support expansion.
blocks.zh: 实验既评价基准业绩,也评价拟议机制。 在NAVSIM导航测试中,ForeseeDrive达到89.2 PDMS和83.5 EP;在nuScenes验证中,它达到了0.41米的平均L2和0.05%的碰撞率;在Bench2Drive中,它达到了76.50的驾驶分数和53.06的成功率. 同一背骨诊断然后从选择中分离出生成:零符号精确地保留了基础候选人,对齐的符号在保存下的选定PDM上略微优于洗牌,TTC重新播放了穿越边界的失败. 甲骨文-最佳质量仍然好坏参半,因此我们将这些诊断解释为可控支持分配的证据,而不是通用支持扩展.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate anticipation in generative driving as a support-allocation problem and expose the structural limit of fixed-candidate future-aware scoring. Second, we introduce a deployable future-token interface that distills logged future evolution into queryable, action-facing variables and injects them before candidate materialization. Third, we develop a restrained integration strategy with exact zero-token preservation, base-candidate regularization, and a TTC-margin guard; we evaluate it across three benchmarks and use controlled diagnostics to separate fixed-menu scoring, mode selection, and generation-time conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们把基因驱动中的预期作为一个支持-分配问题,并暴露出固定候选人未来认知分数的结构限制。 第二,我们引入一个可部署的未来触控界面,它将记录的未来演变成可查询的、可触动的变量,并在候选实现之前注入这些变量。 第三,我们制定限制的整合战略,精确地进行零托肯保存、基准扫描规范化、以及TTC-边际警卫;我们通过三个基准来评估,并使用控制诊断方法来区分固定菜单评分、模式选择和生成时间。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative planners model a distribution over ego futures and materialize multiple trajectories for downstream selection. Diffusion-based planners use iterative denoising and guidance to represent multimodal behavior in prediction, planning, and control [ 12 , 41 , 40 , 16 , 5 , 22 , 57 , 29 ] ; generative end-to-end methods also model ego and traffic evolution in latent or tokenized spaces [ 56 ] . ForeseeDrive complements these generators with supervision that generic guidance does not specify: its query-indexed conditions have logged-future semantics, are predicted online, and enter a zero-token-gated geometry path before selection.
blocks.zh: 基因规划师对自我期货的分布模式,并实现下游选择的多种轨迹. 基于传播的规划者使用迭代调试和指导,在预测、规划和控制中代表多式联运行为[12、41、40、16、5、22、57、29];基因端对端方法还模拟潜在或象征性空间中的自我和交通演变[56]。 预览 Drive对这些生成器加以补充,其监督一般指导没有具体说明:其查询索引条件有登录未来的语义,在线预测,在选择前输入零切入的几何路径.

blocks.en: Motion forecasting models socially plausible trajectories, map-conditioned goals, joint interactions, and multi-agent futures [ 10 , 3 , 35 , 9 , 28 , 54 , 33 , 39 , 32 , 36 ] ; occupancy and BEV forecasting represent evolving free space or world state [ 13 , 31 , 53 , 55 ] . Driving world models and future-aware planners further use imagined visual, BEV, or occupancy futures to guide planning or trajectory evaluation [ 46 , 45 , 52 , 24 ] . Our distinction from this line is the planner interface and its timing: ForeseeDrive compresses future evidence into action-facing queries and injects it before finite candidate materialization, rather than requiring a dense rollout or limiting its use to trajectory evaluation.
blocks.zh: 运动预测模型具有社会合理性的轨迹,以地图为条件的目标,联合互动,以及多代理期货[10,3,35,9,28,54,33,39,32,36];占用和BEV预测代表着不断发展的自由空间或世界状态[13,31,53,55]. 驱动世界模型和未来意识规划者进一步利用想象中的视觉、BEV或占用期货指导规划或轨迹评价[46、45、52、24]。 我们与这条线的区别在于规划器接口及其时间: ForeseeDrive将未来证据压缩成可采取行动的查询,并在有限的候选人实现之前注入,而不是要求密集展开或限制其使用以轨迹评价.

blocks.en: End-to-end driving systems often improve planning by exposing structured intermediate representations, including spatial-temporal BEV features, vectorized scene encodings, object-level planning tokens, interpretable safety cues, and trajectory-guided controls [ 14 , 6 , 15 , 21 , 34 , 38 , 49 ] . These interfaces reduce the burden on a monolithic policy and make planning more controllable. However, most of them primarily encode the current scene, task context, or general safety constraints. ForeseeDrive focuses on a different interface: future-conditioned variables that specify where scene evolution should expand, suppress, or protect ego trajectory modes.
blocks.zh: 端到端驱动系统往往通过曝光结构化中间表现来改进规划,包括空间时空BEV特征,矢量场景编码,物体级规划符,可解释的安全提示,以及轨迹制导控制[14,6,15,21,34,38,49]. 这些接口减轻了单一政策的负担,使规划更具可控性. 然而,它们大多主要编码当前场景,任务背景,或一般的安全限制. ForeeseeDrive专注于不同的界面:未来条件变量,指定场景演化应在哪里扩展,压制,或保护自我轨迹模式.

blocks.en: Logged driving data contains future scene evolution that is unavailable at deployment, making the problem naturally related to learning using privileged information and teacher-student distillation [ 30 , 11 ] . ForeseeDrive follows this train-deploy separation, but the role of privileged information differs from generic feature distillation. The teacher does not simply provide a stronger representation or a future-aware score; it defines action-facing token targets that the student predicts online and that condition generation before candidates are sampled.
blocks.zh: 逻辑驱动数据包含部署时无法获取的未来场景演化,使问题自然与使用特权信息和师生蒸馏法学习有关[30,11]. ForeseeDrive遵循这种列车-调离分离,但特权信息的作用不同于通用特性蒸馏. 教师不简单提供更强的代表性或未来意识分数;它定义了学生在网上预测的、在对考生进行抽样之前创造条件的象征性目标。

blocks.en: Candidate scoring and reranking are effective when a planner already generates a sufficiently diverse set of alternatives. However, selection is structurally limited by the sampled support: a scorer cannot recover a yielding, braking, or nudging maneuver that was never generated. Safety-aware planning and benchmark metrics further expose this issue because small trajectory changes near collision or TTC boundaries can produce discontinuous metric changes [ 37 , 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 如果规划者已经产生一套足够多样化的替代品,候选人的评分和重新排位是有效的。 然而,选择在结构上受到抽样支持的限制:计分器无法恢复从未产生的收成、制动或裸体操作。 安全意识规划和基准指标进一步暴露了这一问题,因为接近碰撞或TTC边界的小轨迹变化可产生不连续的度量变化[37、7、8]。

blocks.en: ForeseeDrive therefore combines generation-time future conditioning with candidate preservation and a TTC-margin guard, targeting support allocation and safety-boundary control.
blocks.zh: 因此,ForeseeDrive将代际未来调节与候选人保存和TTC-边距警卫相结合,瞄准支助分配和安全边界控制。

A selector can only change their ordering, whereas a future-conditioned generator can change the distribution that produces them. The goal of ForeseeDrive is therefore not merely to score trajectories with future evidence, but to allocate candidate support toward maneuvers whose value becomes apparent through anticipated interaction.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate ForeseeDrive on three standard autonomous-driving planning benchmarks: NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes validation planning, and Bench2Drive [ 19 ] . NAVSIM measures closed-loop planning quality with PDMS, EP, NC, DAC, TTC, and comfort. nuScenes measures open-loop trajectory accuracy and collision rate, while Bench2Drive reports closed-loop driving score, success rate, efficiency, and comfort under a multi-scenario protocol. Together, the benchmarks test progress and safety, trajectory fidelity, and closed-loop behavior under complementary conventions.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个标准的自主驾驶规划基准来评价ForeseeDrive:NAVSIM导航测试,nuScens验证规划,以及Bench2Drive [19]. NAVSIM用PDMS、EP、NC、DAC、TTC和舒适度来衡量封闭式规划质量。 nuScenes测量开闭轨轨迹的精确度和碰撞率,而Bench2Drive则根据多场场景协议报告闭闭闭轨驾驶分数,成功率,效率和舒适度. 这些基准共同检验进展和安全性、轨迹忠贞性以及辅助公约下的闭路行为。

blocks.en: We compare ForeseeDrive with representative recent planners within each benchmark’s standard metric layout. The non-ForeseeDrive entries in Tables 1 and 2 come from the corresponding SeerDrive source tables [ 52 ] ; those in Table 3 come from the Hydra-NeXt Bench2Drive table [ 26 ] . The ForeseeDrive rows use the same metric definitions, but these published-table comparisons are not paired reruns. We therefore interpret every table only within its stated protocol and reserve causal claims for the controlled same-backbone diagnostics below.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了ForeseeDrive与每个基准标准度量表内有代表性的近期规划者。 表1和表2中的非ForeseeDrive条目来自相应的SeerDrive源表[52];表3中的条目来自Hydr-NeXt Bench2Drive表[26]. "ForeseeDrive"行使用相同的度量定义,但这些已公布的表格比较不是对对重运行. 因此,我们只在其说明的规程中解释每个表格,并保留对以下受控同背骨诊断的因果关系索赔。

blocks.en: Across benchmarks, ForeseeDrive retains the future-token interface but uses a protocol-specific planner instantiation; the three rows are not a shared checkpoint. On NAVSIM, it is attached to a DiffusionDrive backbone. The nuScenes and Bench2Drive rows follow the backbone, sensor, and metric conventions of their respective layouts. In every case, logged future evolution supplies training targets only; deployment uses present history, map, route, and tracked actors. Unless stated otherwise, the pretrained backbone is frozen, only the token predictor and residual adapters are trained, and candidate selection uses the base planner’s standard selector.
blocks.zh: 纵观基准,ForeseeDrive保留了未来切换界面,但使用特定协议的规划器即时处理;三行不是共享检查点. 在NAVSIM上,它被附着在一个DivusionDrive骨干上. nuScenes和Bench2Drive行遵循各自布局的骨干、传感器和公制惯例。 在每一种情况下,记录下来的未来演变都只提供培训目标;部署使用目前的历史、地图、路线和跟踪行动者。 除非另有说明,预先训练的骨干被冻结,只有象征性的预测器和剩余适配器被训练,候选人的选择使用基准规划器的标准选择器.

blocks.en: For mechanism evidence, we additionally run a candidate-level DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostic that exposes regenerated sets and exact zero-token controls. We compare base and zero-token variants with aligned and shuffled logged-future diagnostic tokens, thereby isolating generator response from predictor accuracy. We report selected and oracle-best PDM, geometry shifts, and mode-logit changes. The TTC analysis replays projection clearance and tests a post-generation fallback, not ℒ guard \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{guard}} training. The appendix gives the full protocol, multi-seed results, sensitivity, and guard aggregates.
blocks.zh: 对于机制证据,我们额外运行了候选级别的扩散Drive/NAVSIM诊断,暴露出再生成的成套和精确的零键控制. 我们把基数和零键变体与对齐和冲洗的记录未来诊断符号进行比较,从而将发电机的反应与预测器的准确性隔离开来。 我们报告选取的和甲骨文-最佳PDM,几何变化,以及模式-记录的变化. TTC分析重播投影清场 测试一代后倒计时 , 不是L guard \ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{guard}} 训练 。 附录给出了完整的协议,多种子结果,灵敏度,以及守护总量.

blocks.zh: 5.2 主要基准结果

blocks.en: On NAVSIM navtest, ForeseeDrive reaches 89.2 PDMS and 83.5 EP, compared with 88.9 and 83.2 for the strongest listed SeerDrive row. It also matches or exceeds the listed rows on NC, DAC, TTC, and comfort. Thus, the higher progress metrics do not come with a degradation in the reported safety or comfort components.
blocks.zh: 在NAVSIM导航测试上,ForeseeDrive达到了89.2PDMS和83.5EP,而列出的最强的SeerDrive列则达到了88.9和83.2. 它还符合或超过NC、DAC、TTC和舒适的列。 因此,较高的进展指标不会随着所报告的安全或舒适部分的退化而出现。

blocks.en: On nuScenes validation, ForeseeDrive attains 0.41 m average L2 and a 0.05% average collision rate, compared with 0.43 m and 0.06% for the listed SeerDrive row. The gains occur at both 2 s and 3 s, where anticipation has more opportunity to affect the trajectory.

blocks.en: On Bench2Drive, ForeseeDrive obtains a 76.50 driving score and 53.06 success rate, compared with 73.86 and 50.00 for the listed Hydra-NeXt row, and records the strongest listed efficiency. This establishes compatibility with a distinct closed-loop planner and protocol. Because the reported sensor configurations differ, however, Table 3 is a protocol-level comparison, not a sensor-matched ablation.
blocks.zh: 在Bench2Drive上,ForeseeDrive获得了76.50的驾驶分数和53.06的成功率,而上市的Hydra-NeXt列车则取得了73.86和50.00的成绩,并记录了最强的上市效率. 这确立了与一个独特的闭路规划和协议的兼容性。 然而,由于所报告的传感器配置不同,表3是一种协议层面的比较,而不是传感器匹配的衰竭。

blocks.en: 5.3 Mechanism and ablation analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 机制和衰减分析

blocks.en: The controlled DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostic asks a narrower causal question: do future tokens affect the generation path in a scene-aligned way without erasing the base planner? Zero tokens leave every candidate unchanged to numerical precision, confirming the architectural no-op. Nonzero tokens alter candidate geometry and mode scores; under preservation, aligned tokens outperform shuffled tokens on selected PDM, although oracle-best candidate quality remains mixed.
blocks.zh: 受控的DivusionDrive/NAVSIM诊断提出了更狭义的因果问题:未来符号是否以场景对接的方式影响生成路径,而不抹去基地规划者? 零符号让每个候选者不变到数字精度,证实了建筑的不开放. 非零符号会改变候选几何和模式的分数;在保存下,对齐的符号在选定的PDM上比被洗牌的符号要好,尽管甲骨文-最佳候选质量仍然参差不齐.

blocks.en: We stress-test the support-allocation claim with targeted fixed-candidate controls; because the splits are selected for headroom, they are mechanism probes rather than unbiased benchmark estimates. A headroom-seeking NAVSIM split found 24 tokens after 79 attempts. On a smaller 12-token split, an official-PDM scorer extracted aligned-future signal from a fixed menu: the best bounded setting improved held-out PDM by +0.0554 over base and +0.0249 over shuffled future. On the expanded split, oracle-best fixed-candidate PDM was +0.1197 above base, yet aligned and shuffled selectors reached only +0.0382 and +0.0350. Thus, fixed-menu headroom exists, but post-hoc reranking converts future signal into selected-plan gains unreliably.
blocks.zh: 我们用目标固定的扫描控制来测试支助分配要求;由于分割是选在头室,因此它们是机制探测器,而不是不带偏见的基准估计。 一个寻找头室的NAVSIM拆分在79次尝试后发现了24个令牌. 在一个更小的12分机上,一个官方-PDM计分器从固定菜单中提取了对齐的未来信号:最佳的定界设置改进了的悬停PDM,比基数为+0.0554,比冲未来为+0.0249. 在扩大的拆分上,甲骨文-最佳的固定封装PDM在基座上方为+0.1197,然而对齐和洗牌的选手只达到+0.0382和+0.0350. 因此,固定菜单头室是存在的,但浩克后重新排位将未来的信号转换成选定的计划收益是不可靠的.

blocks.en: These fixed-menu results sharpen the role of generation-time conditioning. Reranking establishes that useful future signal exists; zero-token and aligned-vs-shuffled controls then test whether it can enter candidate materialization without damaging the base planner. Accordingly, support allocation is a bounded mechanism claim grounded in same-backbone diagnostics. The benchmark tables provide complementary evidence of performance across protocols, not a substitute for controlled candidate analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些固定的菜单结果强化了生成时间调节的作用. 重新排序可以确定有用的未来信号存在;零键和对齐的vs-shuffled控件然后测试它是否能够在无损基础规划器的情况下进入候选物化. 因此,支助分配是一种基于同一背骨诊断的有限度的机制索赔。 基准表提供了跨协议业绩的补充证据,而不是可控候选人分析的替代品。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Frozen-backbone selector probe on a disjoint targeted NAVSIM evaluation subset. Only a tiny future-conditioned mode selector is trained; the DiffusionDrive backbone and candidate geometry are frozen.
blocks.zh: 表4:对一个不相连的NAVSIM评价子集进行冻后骨选择器探测。 只有一个微小的未来条件模式选择器被训练;DifmusionDrive主干和候选几何被冻结.

blocks.en: We further isolate selection from candidate creation with a frozen-backbone selector probe. A small future-conditioned mode-logit selector is trained on a targeted 12-token split and evaluated on a disjoint 12-token subset spanning collision/TTC, progress-failure, partial-progress, and near-margin cases. Table 4 shows that aligned tokens raise selected PDM from 0.176 to 0.378, marginally above the shuffled control at 0.369; zero tokens remain an exact no-op. All-candidate oracle-best PDM stays fixed at 0.810, so this small targeted probe demonstrates selection of under-used existing support, not creation of new oracle support.
blocks.zh: 我们用冷冻的骨骼选择器 进一步将选择与候选人的创建隔离开来 培训了一个小型的未来条件模式记录选择器,内容是有针对性的12个键分裂,并对跨越碰撞/TTC、进度失败、部分进展和近边距的断开的12个子集进行评估。 表4显示,对齐的代号将选定的PDM从0.176提高到0.378,略高于0.369的洗牌控制;零代号仍为完全不动。 所有可扫描的甲骨文-最佳PDM仍固定在0.810,因此这个小型的目标探测器显示选择了使用不足的现有支持,而不是创建新的甲骨文支持.

blocks.en: We also rerun the split48 diagnostic with three seeds. Across 42 token-seed rows, selected aligned PDM changes by +0.000503 on average, with a descriptive bootstrap interval of [+0.000157, +0.000847]; aligned minus shuffled is +0.000205, with interval [+0.000025, +0.000414]. These row-level intervals quantify diagnostic stability rather than benchmark-level significance. Because oracle-best quality remains mixed, the result supports selection direction under preservation, not a general candidate-oracle improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们还用三种种子重新进行分化48诊断。 在42个信物种子行中,选定对齐的PDM平均变化为+0.000503,描述性靴子间隔为[+0.0000157,+0.0000847];对齐的减冲是+0.0000205,间隔为[+0.000025,+0.0000414]. 这些行级间隔量化诊断稳定性而不是基准级意义. 由于甲骨文-最佳质量仍然参差不齐,结果支持保留选择方向,而不是普遍改进候选人-甲骨文。

blocks.en: Together, the ablations separate the key alternatives: fixed-candidate reranking has oracle headroom but mixed selected-plan gains; zero tokens verify base preservation; aligned versus shuffled tokens test scene correspondence; and preservation sweeps measure adapter damage. Appendix Table 7 summarizes the development path and explains why fixed-menu scoring, preservation, and TTC replay form distinct links in the evidence chain.
blocks.zh: 拼凑在一起,将关键替代品分开:固定的扫描重排有甲骨文头室,但混合了选定的计划收益;零符号验证基本保存;对齐和洗牌测试场景通信;保存扫描测量适配器损坏。 附录表7概括了开发路径,并解释了为什么固定菜单评分、保存和TTC重播在证据链中形成不同的环节。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Controlled DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostics. Panels trace the mechanism chain: fixed-candidate reranking has limited deployable gains; zero tokens preserve the base generator; future tokens shift candidates before selection; preservation controls damage; TTC replay localizes failures.
blocks.zh: 图3:受控扩散Drive/NAVSIM诊断. 面板追踪机制链: 固定的指定重排可部署收益有限; 零符号保存基生成器; 未来符号在选择前转移候选对象; 保存控制损坏; TTC 重播本地化失败.

blocks.en: A representative TTC replay localizes a residual safety failure: the base candidate remains TTC-safe, while small aligned and shuffled perturbations cross the 4 s projection boundary after clearing the interacting object by roughly 1 cm. Because the failure is not specific to aligned tokens, the guard is a safety repair rather than a source of future-specific gain. This motivates a narrow hard-crossing and near-boundary rule instead of a broad clearance penalty; the appendix provides the replay details.
blocks.zh: 一个具有代表性的TTC重放一个剩余安全故障:基位候选人仍然TTC安全,而小的对齐和摇晃的扰动在清除了大约1厘米的相互作用物体后越过了4s的投影边界. 由于故障并非专门针对对齐的符号,因此守门员是一种安全修复,而不是未来特定收益的来源. 这激发了狭隘的硬通关和近边界规则,而不是宽泛的通关处罚;附录提供了重播的细节.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ForeseeDrive, a deployable future-token interface that uses privileged future supervision during training and conditions a generative planner before candidates materialize. Results across NAVSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive show strong performance under their respective protocols; same-backbone controls establish exact zero-token preservation, aligned-over-shuffled sensitivity, under-used-mode recovery, and a localized TTC failure. The evidence also defines the limits: benchmark rows are protocol-specific, controlled generation gains are small with mixed oracle quality, and benchmark success does not establish deployment safety. Within these bounds, ForeseeDrive supports a concrete design principle: anticipation should shape generation, while preservation and boundary guards constrain how candidate support may move.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ForeseeDrive,这是一个可部署的未来式接口,在培训期间利用特权的未来监督,并在候选人实现之前提供基因规划员的条件。 整个NAVSIM、nuScens和Bench2Drive的结果表明,根据各自的协议,它们的业绩很强;同背骨控制可以确定精确的零键保存、对齐重叠的敏感度、未充分使用的模式恢复以及局部TTC故障。 证据还定义了限制:基准行是针对协议的,可控生成增益小,混合甲骨文质量,基准成功不能确定部署安全. 在这些范围内, ForeeseeDrive支持具体的设计原则:预期应塑造生成,而保护与边界警卫则制约候选支持如何移动.

Keep these as development evidence, not as the main claim. Candidate access and materialization The original inference path returned only the selected trajectory until a lightweight hook exposed candidate trajectories, scores, and the selected index. Enable later fixed-candidate controls without re-running full evaluation. Fixed-candidate scoring Candidate sets had large oracle headroom, but aligned future features still lost to a no-future selector on the expanded split. Move future information before candidate materialization. Scorer-gate experiments Lightweight scorers were noisy; initial diagnostics were negative and later bounded sweeps were only modestly positive, while complete training rows remained unavailable. Treat scorer learning as a negative or auxiliary branch, not the core claim. Generation-side preservation Naive token injection changed candidates but often hurt official PDM; base-candidate preservation recovered a usable operating region. Add preservation and report selected and oracle-best candidate quality separately. TTC projection replay A centimeter-scale trajectory shift could flip the official TTC component at a narrow boundary. Use a hard-crossing and near-boundary guard instead of a broad clearance penalty.
blocks.zh: 阶段关键观察 对纸质路由级集成的路由同步未来信号的顺序可能影响闭路计分,但路由26950和27515也暴露了基线差异和路由特定的脆弱性. 将这些保留作为发展证据,而不是作为主要索赔。 候选人进入和实现 最初的推断路径只返回选定的轨迹,直到轻量级钩子暴露候选轨迹,分数,以及选定的索引. 启用以后的固定指定控制而不重运行完整的评价 。 固定的提名评分候选人套装有大型的甲骨文头室,但未来特征仍然失去在扩大的拆分上没有未来的选择者。 在候选人实现之前移动未来信息。 计分门实验 轻量级的计分员很吵;最初的诊断是负面的,后来的定界扫射只是略微的阳性,而完整的训练排仍然无法进行. 将记分员学习视为负或辅助分支,而不是核心索赔。 世代保护 正当的象征性注射改变了候选者,但往往伤害了官方的PDM;基准扫描保存恢复了一个可用的操作区域。 添加保存和报告选定和最佳候选人质量。 TTC投影重现一个厘米尺度的轨迹变化,可以在狭窄的边界上翻转正式的TTC组件. 使用硬通关和近界警戒,而不是广泛的通关处罚.

blocks.en: Route-level integration and stability
blocks.zh: 路线一级的一体化和稳定

blocks.en: The first autonomous-driving integration tests used VAD on Bench2Drive routes to verify that learned future signals could be exported, loaded, and consumed inside a closed-loop planner. On route 26950, the actor-future exporter produced route-synchronized coverage over 343 steps, with 308 steps containing groups, 919 groups, and 8271 points. In the same three-way route comparison, the VAD baseline scored 93.584584, while both CV-track reranking and future-point reranking reached 100.0 driving score and 100.0 route completion. The future-point mode changed the selected index on 6 frames, confirming that the future branch could influence candidate selection.
blocks.zh: 第一次自主驾驶集成测试使用Bench2Drive线路上的VAD来验证所学到的未来信号可以在闭路规划器内输出,加载,消耗. 在26950路线上,演员-未来出口商生产了超过343步的路线同步覆盖,其中308步包含团体,919组,8271点. 在同一个三向路线比较中,VAD基线的成绩为93.584584,而CV轨道的重新排名和未来点的重新排名均达到1000.0驾驶分和1000.0路线完成. 未来点模式在6帧上更改了选定的索引,确认未来分支可以影响候选人选择.

blocks.en: Route 27515 was the harder diagnostic. A bounded timeout recovery run completed both baseline and ROI modes: the baseline scored 31.5, the ROI signal mode scored 32.8, route completion stayed at 100.0, and learned-future metadata appeared on 26 of 64 saved frames. That showed the future branch could survive a difficult closed-loop route without evaluator timeouts. Later metadata-only preservation checks exposed the fragility more clearly. On route 26950, a three-condition metadata matrix showed that precomputed future metadata could load on 29 of 33 saved frames and still score 100.0, while the no-track baseline itself dropped to 91.010205 because of a small outside-route-lane infraction. A fresh-port repeat then returned the same baseline to 100.0, which supported runtime variance rather than direct actuation leakage. On route 27515, a preservation matrix improved driving score relative to the low baseline but regressed route completion by 40.27 points in the precomputed-future condition and ended with an agent-blocked failure. Static localization sharpened that failure further: the blocked condition stopped at 59.73% route completion, while the baseline and empty-track controls passed the blocked location. These outcomes made the early VAD/B2D evidence useful for engineering triage but too route-specific for the main claim.
blocks.zh: 27515路线是最难诊断的路线. 完成基线模式和ROI模式的限时恢复:基线得分31.5,ROI信号模式得分32.8,路由完成维持在100.0,64个保存框架中的26个出现了学习未来的元数据。 这表明未来的分支可以在不经过评估超时的情况下度过困难的闭路通道。 后来的仅元数据保存检查更清楚地暴露了脆弱性. 在26950路线上,一个三条条件的元数据矩阵显示,预先计算的未来元数据可以装入33个保存的帧中的29个,并且仍然得分100.0,而无轨基线本身则由于一个小的外行线路违纪而下降到91.010205. 一个新端口的重复随后将同样的基线返回到100.0,这支持运行时间差异而不是直接触发泄漏。 在27515路线上,一个保存矩阵比低基线但后退的路线完成分数在预算未来状态下提高了40.27分,最后以代理锁故障告终. 静态本地化进一步强化了这一故障:阻断状态以59.73%的路由完成率停止,而基线和空轨控制通过阻断位置. 这些结果使早期的VAD/B2D证据对工程分类有用,但对于主要索赔来说过于具体。

blocks.en: Candidate access and one-token materialization
blocks.zh: 候选人进入和一对一的实现

blocks.en: The next milestone was simply exposing the candidate set. The original inference path returned only the selected trajectory, so we added a lightweight hook to expose candidate trajectories, scores, and the selected index. The first extraction materialized a NAVSIM example with 20 candidate trajectories of shape [20, 8, 3] and selected index 19. We then reused that saved row to build base, present-only, shuffled-future, and aligned-future controls over the same candidate set. In this single-scene diagnostic, the aligned future proxy was computable cleanly, but base-regularized selection remained at index 19 and no actor collisions were present. The risk-only ranking moved to index 17, but the base-selected trajectory itself did not change. That split between a computable future signal and a decision-changing future signal became central to the paper.
blocks.zh: 下一个里程碑只是暴露了一组候选人。 最初的推断路径只返回了选定的轨迹,所以我们增加了一个轻量级的钩子来暴露候选轨迹,分数,以及选定的索引. 第一次提取实现一个NAVSIM的例子,有20个候选的形状轨迹[20,8,3]和选定的指数19. 然后我们又重新利用了节省下来的线条来建立基地, 仅限现货, 洗牌未来, 和对同一套选手的对齐未来控制。 在这种单场诊断中,对齐的未来代词是可计算得干净的,但基础规范化的选择仍然停留在指数19,不存在演员碰撞. 仅风险排名移至指数17,但基数选择轨迹本身没有变化. 这一可计算的未来信号与改变决策的未来信号之间的分裂成为文件的核心。

blocks.en: Why fixed-candidate scoring was not enough
blocks.zh: 为什么定点评分还不够

blocks.en: The NAVSIM/DiffusionDrive candidate-level diagnostic was built to isolate candidate support from selector behavior. A headroom-seeking split found 24 tokens with candidate-set headroom after 79 attempts. On a smaller 12-token headroom split, an official-PDM candidate scorer could produce a positive aligned-future signal: the best bounded setting reached a held-out aligned-future delta of +0.055379 versus base, +0.016456 versus a no-future selector, and +0.024876 versus shuffled future. A separate C-oracle candidate scorer then confirmed that aligned-future features are learnable inside a fixed-candidate pipeline, but that still leaves the support bottleneck untouched.
blocks.zh: NAVSIM/DiffusionDrive候选级别的诊断是用来隔离候选支持与选手行为. 在79次尝试后,一个寻找头室的拆分发现了24个带有候选头室的标志. 在一个较小的12个头室拆分时,一个官方-PDM候选计分员可以产生正对齐未来信号:最佳的设定达到了一个被搁置的对齐未来三角洲+0.055379对基座,+0.016456对无未来选择器,+0.024876对冲未来. 随后,一个单独的C-甲骨文候选人计分员证实,在固定的扫描管内,对齐的未来特征是可以学习的,但这仍然使支持瓶颈未受影响.

blocks.en: The larger interface contrast changed the conclusion. On the held-out expanded headroom split, oracle-best fixed-candidate PDM was +0.119660 above base, so the candidate set clearly contained headroom. Yet the best deployable selector was a no-future pairwise ranker at +0.073056, while the best aligned-future method reached only +0.038235 and the best shuffled-future method reached +0.034960. A one-token actor-box proxy run also failed to move the base-regularized selected candidate despite clean aligned future boxes, and a three-token separation diagnostic produced no aligned-unique base-regularized selections. These results support the central interface decision: future evidence should not only rescore a fixed menu; it should condition candidate generation itself.
blocks.zh: 较大的界面对比改变了结论. 在被搁置的扩大的房头拆分上,Oracle-最好固定的封顶PDM在基座上方+0.119660,因此候选人套装中明显包含房头. 然而,最佳可部署选择器是+0.073056的无未来对等分级器,而最佳对称未来法只达到+0.038235,最佳洗涤未来法达到+0.034960. 一个单键演员-盒代理运行也未能移动基态化选手,尽管未来盒保持了干净的对齐,一个三键分离诊断也没有产生任何对齐-唯一基态化选手. 这些结果支持了中央接口的决定:未来的证据不仅应该重回固定的菜单,而且应该对候选人生成本身提出条件。

blocks.en: Scorer-gate experiments and training preconditions
blocks.zh: 分数门试验和培训先决条件

blocks.en: The scorer branch did not end with a single clean win. An early-stopped headroom diagnostic was negative on held-out, with aligned-minus-base and aligned-minus-no-future both below zero, while a later bounded sweep on a headroom-positive split recovered only a modest +0.023718 aligned-minus-base margin. That is enough to show that the signal is not absent, but not enough to make fixed-candidate scoring the main interface.
blocks.zh: 计分员分会没有以一次净胜结束. 早期停靠的头室诊断结果为负值,对齐的减基和对齐的减基和对齐的无未来均低于零,而后期对头室的减基分数的定界扫荡则只恢复了微小的+0.023718对齐的减基差. 这足以表明信号并非缺失,但不足以使固定的扫描评分主界面.

blocks.en: A later training audit separated scorer optimization from real-row data completeness. A fixture-only diagnostic had finite loss, nonzero gradients, checkpoint save/load, and deterministic repeatability with 98 trainable parameters. But real-row training remained blocked by incomplete route context, C3 labels, and dependent target families for route maps, actor motion, occupancy, legality, risk, progress, stagnation, and ranking. The paper uses that branch as a negative control and an input-completeness warning, not as part of the main benchmark claim.
blocks.zh: 后来的培训审计将计分器优化与实时数据完整性分开。 只有固定的诊断方法具有有限的损失、非零梯度、检查点的节省/负荷以及98个可训练参数的确定性重复性。 但是,由于路线背景不完全、C3标签和依赖目标家庭的路线地图、演员运动、占用、合法性、风险、进步、停滞和排名,实际行进培训仍然受阻。 该文件使用该分支作为负控制和输入完成性警告,而不是作为主要基准索赔的一部分。

blocks.en: Generation-side pivot and preservation
blocks.zh: 世代支点和保护

blocks.en: The first frozen-backbone generation adapters established that future tokens could reach the generation path, but they also showed why unconstrained injection is unsafe. A regenerated-candidate official-PDM check for an early PDM-target adapter had aligned oracle-best delta − - 0.001082 and aligned selected delta − - 0.001280 versus base. Other high-gain mode-logit adapters changed candidates more aggressively but often damaged all-candidate oracle quality. The failure mode was not that the adapter was inactive; it was that future-token perturbations could move strong base candidates in scenes where the future signal did not justify the motion.
blocks.zh: 最早的冷冻后骨代适配器确定未来的符符可以到达生成路径,但它们也显示了为何不受约束的注射是不安全的. 重新生成的PDM-目标早期适配器的官方-PDM检查对准了oracle-best delta − - 0.010082,对准了选定的三角塔 − - 0.001280对基准. 其他高收益模式适配器更大幅度地改变了候选人,但往往损害所有候选人的素质。 失败模式不在于适配器不活动;而是未来触控的扰动可以在未来信号不能证明运动合理的情况下移动强基候选人.

blocks.en: Base-candidate preservation produced the stable operating point used in the paper. With a split48 frozen-backbone adapter at gain 0.1 and preservation weight 50, the zero-token path had candidate RMS delta 0.00000000, so the adapter remained an exact no-op under the zero-token control. The best preserved seed reported selected aligned PDM +0.000707 versus base and +0.000105 versus shuffled. Its all-candidate oracle comparison was mixed in absolute terms, but aligned oracle-best exceeded shuffled oracle-best by +0.006399 before post-generation TTC repair. Additional seed checks were useful but more mixed: one seed reached selected aligned +0.000586 while all-candidate oracle-best fell by − - 0.002789, and another reached selected aligned +0.000216 with oracle-best +0.000233. We therefore treat the frozen-backbone diagnostic as mechanism evidence, not as a replacement for the main benchmark tables.
blocks.zh: 碱性罐体保存产生了纸张中使用的稳定操作点。 以0.1增益和保存重量50的分解48冷冻背骨适配器,0托肯路径有候选RMS delta 0.000000,因此适配器在0托肯控制下仍保持精确的不开放. 保存最完好的种子报告选用对齐的PDM+0.000707和+0.000105。 它的全扫描甲骨文比较在绝对值上是混合的,但在生成后TTC修复前,对齐甲骨文-最佳超过洗涤甲骨文-最佳. 更多的种子检查是有用的,但更为混杂:一个种子达到选定对齐+0.000586,而所有可扫描的甲骨文-最佳降幅为−-0.002789,另一个种子达到选定对齐+0.000216,甲骨文-最佳+0.000233。 因此,我们把冷冻后骨诊断作为机制证据,而不是主要基准表的替代。

blocks.en: TTC boundary and guard policy
blocks.zh: TTC 边界和警卫政策

blocks.en: The TTC replay explains why the guard targets boundary crossings rather than clearance shrinkage in general. For token 45510307abe25c1f, candidate 0 has base PDM 1.000000 and TTC component 1.0. Aligned and shuffled future variants both score 0.583333 because TTC flips to 0.0 at ego time 4.0s. The first trigger occurs at a 0.9s future projection against vehicle object 72201d980aa95f34. The base trajectory clears the object by only 0.010833 m, while the token-induced shift is about 0.037 m RMS, enough to cross the official projection boundary.
blocks.zh: TTC重播解释为什么警卫瞄准过境点而不是一般的清关收缩. 对于代号45510307abe25c1f,候选者0拥有基础PDM 1.000和TTC组件1.0. 由于TTC在自负时间4.0s时翻转到0.0,因此Accessed和shuffled未来变体都得分0.583333. 第一个触发器发生在未来对车辆物体72201d980aa95f34的0.9s投影时. 基础轨迹使物体的清空距离只有0.010833米,而令牌引发的转向距离约为0.037米 RMS,足以跨越官方投影边界.

blocks.en: The full projection-clearance extraction evaluated 216 variant rows from 54 high-PDM, TTC-safe base candidates and exactly matched the official scores. In the main preserved run, hard TTC-boundary crossings occurred for 1 aligned row, 2 shuffled rows, and 0 zero-token rows. A hard-cross fallback closed the residual aligned oracle-best gap from − - 0.000653 to +0.000220 versus base, but shuffled also improved to +0.000424. This is why the guard is described as safety repair rather than a source of future-specific gain. Dense clearance statistics were less decisive: aligned had mean clearance loss 0.033203 m and shuffled 0.024417 m, even though aligned had fewer hard crossings. The policy implication is to guard hard safe-to-unsafe TTC transitions and a narrow near-contact band, while avoiding a broad loss that punishes every controlled approach to another actor.
blocks.zh: 全部投影清查从54个高PDM、TTC安全基数候选人中评估了216个变种行,并完全与官方得分相符。 在主保存的运行中,发生了1个对齐行,2个摇摆行和0个零键行的硬TTC边界交叉. 硬十字倒转关闭了剩余对齐的甲骨文-最佳缺口,从−0.000653到+0.0000220对基,但洗牌也改进为+0.0000424. 这就是为什么警卫被描述为安全维修而不是未来特定收益的来源. 密集清关统计数字的决定性程度较低:统一清关损失为0.033203米和洗牌0.024417米,尽管统一清关的硬度过境点较少。 政策含义是保护安全到不安全的TTC的艰难过渡和狭窄的近接触带,同时避免造成广泛的损失,从而惩罚对另一角色采取每一种受控制的做法。

blocks.en: Controlled ablations: robustness, sensitivity, and guard aggregates
blocks.zh: 控制下的淤积:坚固性、敏感性和警戒总量

blocks.en: We include only completed controlled diagnostics that are directly tied to the DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM setting and are safe to interpret as mechanism evidence. Preliminary engineering checks on other protocols are excluded from the evidence chain.
blocks.zh: 我们只包括与DivusionDrive/NAVSIM设置直接相连的完整控制诊断,并且可以安全地将诊断解释为机制证据。 其他协议的初步工程检查被排除在证据链之外。

blocks.en: The same multiseed run provides a component-level diagnostic. Zero future tokens exactly match the base condition across selected and oracle-best rows. For selected trajectories, aligned future improves PDM by +0.000503 and ego-progress by +0.001207, while collision, TTC, comfort, and drivable-area components do not change at the aggregate level. Shuffled future also improves progress, but less (+0.000714). Oracle-best rows are more conservative: aligned future reduces oracle-best PDM by − - 0.001070, primarily through a progress decrease of − - 0.002568, while shuffled is lower still. This component pattern matches the main interpretation: preservation makes selected behavior mildly better and keeps safety components stable, but the diagnostic remains bounded and does not replace the main benchmark tables.
blocks.zh: 同样的多种子跑提供了组件级诊断. 未来0个符号完全匹配 整个选定和甲骨文最佳行的基准条件。 对于选定的轨迹,对齐的未来将PDM提高+0.000503,自我进步提高+0.001207,而碰撞、TTC、舒适度和可驾驶区域组件在总水平上没有变化。 动荡的未来也改善进步,但减少(+0.0714)。 甲骨文-最佳排位比较保守:对齐的未来将甲骨文-最佳PDM减少−-0.001070,主要通过进度减少−-0.002568,而洗牌仍然较低. 这种组件模式与主解释相符:保存使选定的行为稍有改善,并保持安全组件的稳定,但诊断仍然有限制,不会取代主基准表.

blocks.en: Several completed gain/preservation sweeps support the same cautious operating point. With gain 0.05 and preservation weight 50, selected aligned PDM improves by +0.000278 and oracle-best changes by − - 0.000764; increasing preservation to 100 gives selected +0.000317 and oracle-best − - 0.000734.
blocks.zh: 一些已完成的增益/保全扫描支持同样的谨慎操作点. 使用增益0.05和保全重量50,选定对齐的PDM改进了+0.000278,甲骨文最佳变化改进了−-0.000764;将保全增加至100,使选定+0.000317和甲骨文最佳改进了−0.000734.

blocks.en: Gain 0.075, preservation 50, gives selected +0.000455 and oracle-best − - 0.000733. The reported operating point, gain 0.1 and preservation 50, gives selected +0.000707 and oracle-best − - 0.000653, while preservation 100 gives selected +0.000860 and oracle-best − - 0.000529 but fails the stricter candidate-generation gate. Progress-augmented variants at gain 0.1, preservation 50, remain similar (selected +0.000680 to +0.000678; oracle-best about − - 0.00069). These sweeps show that preservation controls damage from token injection, but they also show why the paper reports the diagnostic as mechanism evidence rather than an end-to-end ablation.
blocks.zh: 0.075, 保存50, 给选择的+0.000455 和 oracle- best - - 0.0000733. 报告的操作点(增益0.1和保全50)给选定的+0.000707和甲骨文最佳−-0.000653,而保全100给选定的+0.000860和甲骨文最佳−-0.000529,但未能提供更严格的候选生成门。 增益0.1的增益变体,保存50,仍然相似(选用+0.000680至+0.000678;甲骨文-最佳约−-0.000069). 这些扫描显示,保存控制了象征性注射的损坏,但也显示了为什么论文将诊断作为机制证据而不是端到端的萎缩报告.

blocks.en: The TTC guard was evaluated as a post-generation fallback over regenerated candidates for the same three split48 seeds. This is not guard training. Across seeds, raw aligned oracle-best delta averages − - 0.001070; hard-cross fallback changes this to +0.000143, for a mean guard improvement of +0.001213. The fallback improves aligned oracle-best in two of the three seeds and makes aligned nonnegative in two seeds. It blocks two aligned hard-cross rows and two shuffled hard-cross rows in total. However, the hard-cross fallback aligned-minus-shuffled oracle-best mean is − - 0.000043, so the guard should not be read as an aligned-specific gain. Its role is failure-mode closure: it repairs brittle safe-to-unsafe TTC crossings that can affect either aligned or shuffled perturbations.
blocks.zh: TTC后卫被评为一代后倒计时,为同一三颗分裂48种子的再生选手. 这不是警卫训练。 在整个种子中,原始对齐的甲骨文-最佳三角洲平均− - 0.001070;硬反倒数将这个变化为+0.000143,平均卫护改进为+0.0113。 倒背在三个种子中有两个改进了对齐的oracle-最好,在两个种子中使对齐的非负面. 它总共阻断了两条对齐的硬十字线和两条摇摆的硬十字线. 然而,硬反倒向对齐的折射角-最佳平均值为 − - 0.000043,因此卫视不应被解读为对齐的特定收益. 其作用是故障模式关闭:修复安全到不安全的TTC路口,这些路口既可影响对接的路口,也可影响摇晃的路口。

blocks.en: These selected diagnostics address uncertainty and component-level evidence while keeping the claim boundary intact. They support four narrow conclusions: zero-token preservation is exact; aligned future tokens give a small selected-PDM advantage over shuffled under preservation; oracle-best candidate quality remains mixed in the frozen diagnostic; and hard TTC-boundary fallback repairs a localized safety failure but is not itself the source of future-specific improvement.
blocks.zh: 这些选定的诊断方法处理不确定性和组成部分层面的证据,同时保持索赔边界不变。 他们支持四个狭义的结论:零托肯保存准确;与保存下的洗牌相比,对齐的未来标志给予小的选定PDM优势;甲骨文最佳候选质量在冷冻诊断中依然混合;硬的TTC边界倒置修复局部安全故障,但本身并不是未来特定改进的来源.

blocks.en: What remains outside the main claim
blocks.zh: B. 主要索赔以外的内容

blocks.en: Several diagnostics above are intentionally excluded from the main benchmark claim. The VAD/B2D route checks used route-specific future metadata and runtime-sensitive CARLA conditions. The fixed-candidate NAVSIM runs showed useful upper bounds but did not establish a deployable aligned-future selector. The frozen generation adapters were tiny, frozen-backbone diagnostics rather than full planner finetunes. The scorer audits showed that some future signal is learnable, but only after candidate materialization and only under incomplete training rows. These studies nevertheless shaped the final method: they motivated generation-time future tokens, exact zero-token controls, base-candidate preservation, and the narrow TTC-margin guard used in the main narrative.
blocks.zh: 上文的一些诊断被故意排除在主要基准索赔之外。 VAD/B2D路由检查使用了特定路由的未来元数据以及运行时敏感的CARLA条件. 固定扫描的NAVSIM运行显示有用的上限,但没有建立可部署的对齐未来选择器。 冷冻的一代适配器是微小的,冷冻的后骨诊断,而不是完整的计划器微调. 计分员审计显示,有些未来的信号是可以学习的,但只有在候选人实现后,并且只在不完整的训练排下才能学习. 尽管如此,这些研究还是塑造了最终方法:它们激发了代代未来符号,精确的零托肯控制,基础-扫描保存,以及主叙事中使用的狭义的TTC-边际护卫.

blocks.en: Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 更大的影响

blocks.en: This work aims to improve anticipation and safety-sensitive planning in autonomous driving, but it should not be interpreted as validating deployment readiness. Future-conditioned generation can introduce new failure modes if predicted tokens are miscalibrated or if the planner overreacts to uncertain interactions. Any deployment would require closed-loop validation, safety monitoring, redundancy, and human oversight beyond the offline and benchmark evidence reported here.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在改善自主驾驶方面的预期和安全规划,但不应被解释为验证部署准备情况。 未来有条件的一代可以引入新的失败模式,如果预测的符号被错校,或者如果规划者对不确定的相互作用反应过度. 任何部署都需要离线验证、安全监测、冗余和人员监督,超出本节报告的离线和基准证据。
